command: PRO9_FISCAL_MYSQL_TESTS=1 PRO9_FISCAL_TIMING=1 DB_HOST=127.0.0.1 DB_PORT=3306 php vendor/bin/phpunit -c informes/evidencias/vendeya-offline/final-suite.xml --filter 'SellnowSalePersistenceTest|test_api_invoice_from_restaurant_checks_method_currency_and_bank_atomically|test_api_sale_note_rejects_retired_currency_and_rolls_back_imported_customer' --log-junit informes/evidencias/vendeya-offline/final-junit.xml
validation: Native document and sale-note normalization, calculation, payments, inventory and cash ledgers in disposable MySQL databases.
Concurrent separate PHP processes, lost response after commit, unchanged UUID replay and changed-content HTTP409.
Closed cash and explicit authorized reassignment preserve original envelope/hash and selected cash for bank and cash receipts.
Twelve-decimal HALF_UP transfer boundary for rational quantity multiplied by rational price, on invoice and note.
Durable PDF retry, expired print claim overlap, one print queue row and no repeated uncertain email.
Recovery --limit=1 respected; permanent failures do not prevent newer work on the following run.
Production HTTP kernel, Bearer authentication, ownership isolation, offline context authorized cash list and real PDF download.
Existing invoice APIs in digital/free-form modes and legacy sale-note rejection preserve atomic rollback.
boundaries: No commercial invoice, note, payment or stock movement was created in BBC; the tenant operation count is 0 in bbc-application-receipt.json.
Physical printers, real SMTP and remote fiscal providers were not used; queue insertions and transport failures are controlled tests.

teardown.mechanism: FiscalEmissionSchemaTest::tearDown rolls back any open tenant transaction, drops its unique pro9_fiscal_test_<12hex> database and removes its temporary files. FiscalTemporaryDatabases adds shutdown cleanup for databases owned by that process.
teardown.note: Four schemas date from 2026-10-23 through 2026-11-03; one partial 214-table fixture dates from 2026-11-12T02:44UTC. None has an active connection. These residual schemas were not removed because ownership was not established by the completed final run.
